cases.refreshed: Bring the kids to Music and Movement in the King Library Children's Room, held every Wednesday.
cases.reviewed: On Wednesdays, bring the kids to the King Library Children's Room for stories, songs, and movement.

cases.refreshed: Join a Wednesday afternoon STEAM session with activities ranging from robots to engineering, science and making.
cases.reviewed: Make things, try robotics, or explore engineering and science at this Wednesday afternoon STEAM Club.

cases.refreshed: Join a leadership and volunteer service group for teens ages 13-18, meeting Wednesday afternoons to earn volunteer hours and take on leader roles in the library.
cases.reviewed: Teens ages 13–18 can earn volunteer hours and take on leadership roles at the library. The group meets on Wednesday afternoons.

cases.refreshed: Tell a story to a Furry Friend! Children are invited to practice reading to gentle, trained assistance dogs who love books! Practice reading skills while relaxing next to a cute Furry Friend. You can use this program to reduce fines and fees for lost or damaged items. The library deducts $5 from juvenile accounts for every 15 minutes you are read to. Please check in at the 2nd Floor Info Desk for additional information. For youth ages 0-10. Free. No registration required.
